completion_promises.criterion_text: enqueue_notification appends to a session-scoped FIFO; FIFO is created on first call.
completion_promises.evidence: SessionManager.enqueue_notification lazy-creates collections.deque(maxlen=cap) on first call per session_id. _notification_queues dict is keyed on session_id; deque.append preserves FIFO order. Test class TestAC001LazyFifoAndConstructionCap.test_enqueue_creates_fifo_on_first_call verifies the lazy creation, and TestACBoundaryFillAndDrain.test_enqueue_cap_items_drains_all_in_fifo_order verifies arrival order.

completion_promises.criterion_text: When the queue is at cap, oldest entry is evicted before the new one is appended; one WARN log line per overflow.
completion_promises.evidence: enqueue_notification checks `if len(queue) >= cap` BEFORE append and emits exactly one WARN forge_notification_queue_overflow via _stdlib_logger (with cap and evicted_correlation_id in the extra dict). The deque(maxlen=cap) handles the actual eviction. TestAC002OverflowEvictsOldestWithWarn.test_overflow_evicts_oldest_and_logs_warn_once asserts both invariants — only the latest cap entries survive, and exactly one WARN record is captured.

completion_promises.criterion_text: pending_notifications returns + clears atomically (no notification can be double-rendered or lost between drain and clear).
completion_promises.evidence: pending_notifications builds `drained = list(queue)` then calls `queue.clear()` with no await between them — atomic on the single asyncio loop (ASSUM-003). TestAC003AtomicDrainReentrySafe.test_two_sequential_drains_no_duplicates and test_drain_then_enqueue_then_drain_preserves_only_new_entries verify both the empty-second-drain invariant and the no-leak invariant across drain/enqueue/drain.

completion_promises.criterion_text: end_session clears the per-session queue; subsequent enqueue_notification for that session_id is silently dropped (no raise).
completion_promises.evidence: end_session adds session_id to self._ended and pops the queue from self._notification_queues. enqueue_notification's first check `if session_id in self._ended or session_id not in self._sessions` early-returns with a DEBUG forge_notification_dropped log line — no raise. TestAC004EndSessionClearsAndDrops covers both clearing and the silent-drop on subsequent enqueue.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Cap value is read once from JarvisConfig.forge_notifications_queue_cap at construction time, not per-call.
completion_promises.evidence: SessionManager.__init__ accepts queue_cap (defaults to 100) and snapshots it as self._notification_queue_cap. enqueue_notification reads `cap = self._notification_queue_cap` once per call but the value is the construction-time snapshot — JarvisConfig is never re-read. The lifecycle wiring (TASK-J005-008) will pass config.forge_notifications_queue_cap as queue_cap. TestAC001LazyFifoAndConstructionCap.test_construction_reads_cap_once asserts the snapshot attribute exists and that 5 enqueues with cap=3 yield only the latest 3.
